scope: Chinese darknet seller alias identification under controlled sequential arrival; top-venue literature from 2016–2026; proposal only.
reviewer_identity_evidence: The visible ChatGPT selector displayed 6 / Pro before submission and with the final reply; UI identity only, not an independent backend attestation.
prompt:
请审查唯一附件 SELLER_ALIAS_CONTINUAL.zh.md。这是中文暗网卖家同控马甲识别项目的选题与最小可行性方案，不是已冻结的实验或实现。用户希望容易实施，要求主要依据为近十年顶刊顶会论文。附件 SHA-256：8384723a53ccbdc2ba3704f37970661d7f70005abaff8cad0a8a536bb2bb755d，15805 字节。

请只给一次有取舍的科学审查，约 1500—2200 中文字：
1. 研究问题是否成立、现有同源合成世界分批能否支持所说的遗忘；随机到达与受控非同分布、训练身份与评价身份是否区分正确。
2. 对照是否有关键缺项或不公平，尤其固定输入、小型二分类头、字节记忆预算、DER++ 适配、冻结模型与累计重训。
3. “同一锚点正负关系成组保留”相对 MIR/GSS/DER++ 及近年持续重识别是否仅是普通方法改名；不要凭没有检索命中就断言首创，也不要仅因有近邻就否决尝试简单基线。
4. 指出真正会使结论无效的缺陷与最小补充；剩余风险与待验证假设分开写。仅在有确切原始来源时补充遗漏的 2016—2026 顶会/顶刊近邻。

边界：已有四臂六预算迁移有效负结果保持停止；不重新调旧模型、不使用 Audit A/B 真值、不需要新增真实中文标签、当前不使用 Linux。57 项特征只是第一轮可行性参照，不把小头结果直接写成真实市场有效或完整方法贡献。具体阶段分布、记忆序列化字节、优化超参数尚待本地核验，不能把草案中明确待定的实现细节伪称已实现错误。你没有源码和数据，不能宣布实现已通过。请逐条将必要修改归类为 SCIENTIFIC_BLOCKER 或 REPRODUCIBILITY_DEFECT，说明受影响结论与最小修复；无关复杂机制列 OUT_OF_SCOPE_OVERDESIGN 并拒绝。不提出网络/安全/签名/繁琐审批/重复外审/大规模基线矩阵。你是咨询审查者，最终采用与否由本地执行者独立判断。
reply_text:
已完整读取附件：15,805 字节，SHA-256 与你提供的值完全一致。我的取舍是：**保留为四臂可行性候选，暂不把“共同锚点成组记忆”立为方法贡献。**未发现足以否决首轮探索的已证实科学错误。

一、问题成立，但合成分批不自动证明遗忘

附件正确区分固定同控二分类与身份类增量，也正确要求训练、评价身份隔离。评价身份从未参与训练，不妨碍检验“已学分布上的泛化保持”；这里的“旧”应指已覆盖的分布，而非模型见过那些开发账号。

SELLER_ALIAS_CONTINUAL.zh

同源世界随机分批可以检验顺序更新后的退化，不能仅凭五个分组及 BWT/F 命名为跨域遗忘。受控非同分布方案须保持世界完整，并核验公开划分是否对应模型实际输入或判别条件的变化；商品类别不同，不保证57维成对输入不同。开发侧采用对应规则、禁止依据未来结果挑顺序，这些边界正确。阶段差异尚未证实属于待验证假设，不是已经发生的实现错误。

SELLER_ALIAS_CONTINUAL.zh

固定输入、小头适合隔离打分函数的更新干扰，但排除了编码器遗忘及新旧表示不兼容；C2R（CVPR 2024）专门涉及后一问题。因此，小头无遗忘不能否定完整系统存在困难，有遗忘也不能外推真实市场。
CVF开放访问
 固定候选库应保留，新增竞争者引起的排名下降不能计作遗忘。

SELLER_ALIAS_CONTINUAL.zh

二、近邻不等于重复，但“关系保持”不是空白

MIR（NeurIPS 2019）按预计损失增量选择当前重放样本；GSS（同年）按梯度多样性选择入库样本。共同锚点约束改变边的联合入选方式，不与二者定义等同，但换存储单位也不足以证明创新。
NeurIPS Proceedings
+1

建议只补一篇直接近邻：Huang 等的 CLUDA-ReID，CVPR 2022，题名《Lifelong Unsupervised Domain Adaptive Person Re-Identification With Coordinated Anti-Forgetting and Adaptation》。原文已有身份级 reservoir、协调重放和实例关系一致性；其无监督视觉表示设定不同，不能据此断言你的二分类成组缓存已被解决。
CVF开放访问
+1
 附件所列 VLADR 原文也已有跨实例关系矩阵蒸馏。
arXiv
 应收窄贡献，而非仅因有近邻放弃简单基线。

三、必要修改及受影响结论

SCIENTIFIC_BLOCKER——共同锚点贡献的归因，仅阻断后续方法结论。
现有“分层随机、随机成组、MIR”仍未明确排除难负例选择的作用。按附件的固定成对输入、ID不进头、独立二分类损失，两条边的损失仍相加，成组本身没有增加损失层面的关系约束。

SELLER_ALIAS_CONTINUAL.zh

 最小补充是：设置取消共同锚点约束，但匹配正负比例、难度及重复次数的独立边对照，保持字节与计算口径一致。否则增益只能归于整个选择策略，不能归于共同锚点；这不阻断先做四臂。

REPRODUCIBILITY_DEFECT——DER++适配尚需补清规范。
按原文式6、算法2，采用“当前 BCE＋α历史 logit 平方误差＋β历史标签 BCE”；历史输出应保存为固定目标，并明确相对参数更新的保存时点，蒸馏与监督分别抽样。合用一个批次并非必然无效，但须标明采样变体，而非声称逐项复现。
NeurIPS Proceedings
 单 logit 蒸馏仍是合理参照，但保持的是标量输出，不应照搬多类别关系的解释。此项影响强基线比较是否可复现，不表示已有代码写错。

REPRODUCIBILITY_DEFECT——预算与参照臂口径尚需闭合。
附件已有按真实字节计量、报告附加计算的正确原则。

SELLER_ALIAS_CONTINUAL.zh

 需要补清：“同更新次数、同新旧配比”不能覆盖冻结臂和无重放臂；重放总量须合计 DER++两次抽样，MIR选样开销也须入账。等步数不等计算，单报耗时不足以支持“等计算预算更优”。各法按真实必要状态计费，允许 ER 利用省下的 logit 或标识字节多存边；调参机会应对称，不要求正则系数相等。

冻结臂应固定全部评分状态；累计重训应明确每阶段是否重置头与优化器、仅使用截至当期历史，并保持相同预处理。沿用上一模型则应说明是累计历史微调。累计重训可以作为超预算效果／成本参照，无须强压成同预算，更不是数学上界。

REPRODUCIBILITY_DEFECT——到达与组操作尚需定义。
补清阶段内重复训练是否再次触发 reservoir、组内重复边如何计数，以及只成组入库还是也成组回放。否则缓存分布、样本权重和批次相关性可能混在一起，无法复现或归因。具体阶段分布、序列化大小和超参数尚待核验，本身不计为已发生缺陷；这里要求的是使用前补齐语义。

四、风险、假设与最终取舍

剩余风险是强规则掩盖、反复使用开发集及三个顺序覆盖有限。应保留规则外分层，结果只作探索；世界重采样描述给定模型与顺序下的评价不确定性，并不覆盖全部训练随机性。无需因此立刻扩展种子矩阵。

SELLER_ALIAS_CONTINUAL.zh +1

待验证假设是头确实学会识别、存在可靠旧分布退化，以及 ER 仍有明显不足。若只有随机波动或 ER 已解决问题，不应人为制造遗忘来升级方法贡献。

**OUT_OF_SCOPE_OVERDESIGN：**拒绝为本轮增加视觉语言网络、复杂图机制、大规模基线矩阵或额外审批。冻结、继续训练、ER、累计重训足够回答首轮可行性；出现可解释的不足后，再补直接强参照和归因对照。旧迁移负结果保持停止，不需新增真实中文标签，不动 Audit A/B 与 Linux 边界。建议保留候选，但不认定方法贡献，也不认定实现通过。
reviewed_file_scope: One proposal document; no code, arrays, raw account records or labels. The review does not certify implementation correctness.

local_decisions.claim: Improvement specifically attributable to common-anchor memory selection.
local_decisions.finding: Pointwise BCE is additive; grouping can also change negative difficulty, class allocation, repetition and update scheduling.
local_decisions.minimal_remedy: Keep the same head/loss; compare independent edges matched on positive proportion, negative difficulty and repetitions under actual byte/compute accounting. First change joint retention only and replay independent edges. If attribution cannot be isolated, report only the complete strategy effect.

independent_check.additive_pair_loss: For the proposed pointwise BCE head, fixing the exact replay edges and their weights gives the same full-batch objective regardless of anchor grouping. Grouping can affect which edges are retained and minibatch gradient variance/order, but does not itself add model-visible relational evidence. Before a relation-grouping contribution, compare a selected memory with the same edges replayed independently and distinguish selection from batch scheduling; no new objective is authorized by this observation.
independent_check.data_hypothesis: All worlds have the same complete 28-account pair graph. A claim about high-degree account popularity causing reservoir bias has no support here. The draft already discloses this.
independent_check.budget: Whole-history 57-feature data are small, so memory constraint is experimental, not an established operational bottleneck.

local_decisions.finding: Scalar-target timing and two replay draws need explicit semantics.
local_decisions.minimal_remedy: Specify current BCE + alpha scalar-logit MSE + beta old-label BCE; save the first-arrival pre-update logit as a fixed target. Sample both memory terms separately and count both. Do not inherit multiclass-logit interpretations.
local_decisions.verification: Locally read NeurIPS 2020 Eq. 5–6 and Algorithms 1–2; no implementation executed.

local_decisions.finding: Equal replay ratios cannot cover frozen/no-replay arms; equal steps are not equal compute; ER need not store unused metadata.
local_decisions.minimal_remedy: Apply matching rules only to applicable arms, count selection/replay work and allow ER additional rows with saved bytes. Freeze all score states. Reset head and optimizer for prefix-only cumulative retraining with common preprocessing, as a separately priced reference.

local_decisions.claim: Defined memory probabilities, weights and arrival process.
local_decisions.finding: Repeated epochs, overlapping group edges and batch grouping can confound retention.
local_decisions.minimal_remedy: One arrival event per unique original pair; no epoch-based reinsertion. Count unique payloads plus group metadata, record weights/repetitions, and separate retention from replay scheduling.

local_decisions.finding: Different categories need not change the actual 57-feature inputs; same-generator random cohorts are not automatically domains.
local_decisions.minimal_remedy: Verify model-visible distributions, preserve world completeness and identity isolation, and interpret random cohorts accordingly. Fixed-head null results do not rule out encoder forgetting.

local_decisions.finding: CLUDA-ReID, CVPR 2022, already uses identity-wise reservoir and relational consistency.
local_decisions.minimal_remedy: Add the direct neighbor with its unsupervised visual/pseudo-identity setting.
local_decisions.reading_scope: Official indexed abstract, main introduction, supplemental Section 1 and Algorithm 1. Direct opens returned 403; indexed primary-source text was read. No full implementation audit.

local_decisions.claim: No present need for visual-language architectures, graph mechanisms, broad benchmark matrices or additional approval procedures.
local_decisions.minimal_remedy: Keep four initial feasibility arms; add direct controls only for later method claims.

local_disposition: Retain the candidate for local feasibility; no novel selector or algorithm mainline is established. Next inspect whether public grouping yields model-visible variation, then define the smallest comparison.
post_submission_changes: Expanded actual GSS/DKC reading scope; independently derived BCE additivity before reading the final review; added verified CLUDA-ReID and minimal attribution/replay/budget clarifications. No new experiment or second review.
